Hans Harisson commented on The Brainstorms Festival 2021 x NeuroTechX: "Mail d'Adam : 

Sabria, Szabi,

I wanted to follow up quickly on the 2points we discussed during last week's call re our participation in your upcoming event:
Participation during the event (Presentation + Booth) - Please note that Hans and Radhika (both CCed) will be our representatives for NeuroTechX (Hans) and NeuroTechX Services (Radhika) - Please provide some info on logistics and next steps in that regard (e.g., Days/Times, Medium (PPT Pres, Live discussions, etc.))
NeuroTechX Community - Tickets for (more) underprivileged chapters - We could provide 2-3 tickets per Chapter to our LATAM, India, and potentially Russian chapters - Let us know what you have in mind: do you need names and e-mails or can you send us tickets we can share with each chapter? "
